scope: Independent four-connected components, summaries, integer pixel grid, zero-depth exclusion, RGB dimensions/orientation/hash and algebraic projection roundtrip. No raycast repeated. Full saved ray evaluation and pose/registration already reviewed separately.
caveats: Post-hoc selected regions; not unbiased scene-wide accuracy.
All distances axial metres, not Euclidean range.
Some recorded depths exceed fusion input cutoff; do not assume all corresponding surfaces were observed in training.
Display extent uses raster bins; numerical labels use exact stride-4 integer coordinates.
Observed earlier/later reconstructed first hits do not uniquely identify drift, truncation, changed furniture or implementation cause.
No measured-reference mask or physical hazard labels; no safety or false-clear/block rate.
